# United Rubber Cork

> United Rubber Cork supplies cork and rubberised cork products for industrial,
> construction and insulation, decorative, and gifting applications. It is
> based in GIDC, Vapi, Gujarat, India.

Use the routes below as the source for public website content. Product facts
are limited to published information; availability and unconfirmed details
should be checked with the company. The canonical domain has not been
confirmed, so links are site-relative.

## Main pages

- [Home](/): Company and product overview.
- [Products](/products): Product family index.
- [Industries](/industries): Documented applications.
- [Quality](/quality): Published standards and certification caveats.
- [About](/about): Company and product overview.
- [Contact](/contact): Current published contact details and quote instructions.
- [Privacy](/privacy): Website privacy notice.

## Product pages

- [Rubberised cork](/products/rubberised-cork): Sheets, gaskets, frames, strips
  and washers.
- [Cork](/products/cork): Sheets and rolls, rings and gaskets, polishing wheels,
  granules, anti-vibration slabs, Battricork and stoppers.
- [Decorative cork](/products/decorative-cork): Tiles and memo boards.
- [Cork gifts](/products/cork-gifts): Gift products by enquiry.
